Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid
Hybrid reservoir, well and network production model: reservoir simulator results supply the depletion behaviour and NeqSim supplies the well, network and fluid response.

A production profile replayed from a reservoir simulator gives the same rate at a given cumulative production whatever the network does. The classes in this package instead keep the reservoir state from the simulator (pressure, water cut, gas-oil ratio, productivity index and optionally composition as functions of the cumulative volumes) and solve the well rates from inflow performance, lift curves and network back-pressure, so the rates respond when a choke, another well, the separator pressure, the routing or a facility capacity changes.

Layers

  • Reservoir-state proxy: ReservoirStateProxy (one simulator run), ScenarioReservoirState (interpolation between runs on a second cumulative volume such as cumulative injection).
  • Well: HybridWell (inflow performance, tubing lift curve, choke and rate target).
  • Lift curves: VfpTableLookup (VFPPROD tables read the way a simulator reads them) and CorrectedVlpProvider (fast curve corrected against a live multiphase model).
  • Network: GatheringNetwork (manifolds, flowlines, risers and a fixed-pressure boundary).
  • Fluid: MolarFeedAdapter (well rates to component molar rates).
  • Solver: HybridProductionModel (coupled well and network solve, time stepping, fidelity modes, facility capacities) with HybridStepResult snapshots.

Reading Eclipse or OPM Flow results into proxy tables is done outside this package (Python, resdata); the tables enter as arrays or comma-separated files.

    Time integration of the cumulative volumes.

    ReservoirStateProxy
    Tabulated reservoir-state proxy from one reservoir simulator run: reservoir pressure, water cut, gas-oil ratio, productivity index and optional wellstream composition as functions of one cumulative volume.
    ReservoirStateWellBinding
    Applies a simulator-derived reservoir state to an existing production WellSystem.
    ScenarioReservoirState
    Reservoir-state proxy that interpolates between several reservoir simulator scenarios.
    VfpTableLookup
    Lift curve lookup in a METRIC VFPPROD table, read the way Eclipse and OPM Flow read it: multilinear interpolation in rate, outlet pressure, water ratio and gas ratio, with linear extrapolation outside the axes.
